author: mino
name: exposure_vignette
description: A keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+E) that creates a new exposure module instance, applies a 'vignette' exposure preset and adds an ellipse mask, for quick scene-referred vignetting. Requires a matching exposure preset named 'vignette' (the included exposure_vignette.dtpreset).
description-extensive: A one-key shortcut (Ctrl+E) for quickly adding a natural-looking vignette (darkened edges) to a photo. Pressing it creates a new exposure adjustment, applies a saved "vignette" preset, and adds an oval mask so the effect fades toward the center. It requires you to have a matching exposure preset named "vignette" installed (the included exposure_vignette.dtpreset file provides one). This one is somewhat experimental and may not work perfectly on every darktable version.
